_about: The graphite treatment of each drawn front (scripts/site/graphite.py). The case body takes the site's --case graphite; every other color keeps its lightness distance from the vendor's case color, scaled by `contrast`, so a key stays a key and a legend stays legible. A light-bodied board inverts that distance (its dark keys become the light ones on a dark body). `glass` lists the colors that belong to the front glass and its print: those keep their own polarity around `glass_base`, whatever the body does, because the glass of a white board is still black. Only the captured screen is ever in color.
